subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw treat Volcano Engine Lite/Coding Plan UUID-like keys when a user selects a general Volcengine model such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: Source shows a real setup/runtime split, but only credentialed Volcengine proof can distinguish a wrong endpoint, unsupported entitlement, or missing diagnostic before maintainers choose the product behavior.

options.title: Validate Lite routing first
options.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/Coding Plan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys coding-only
options.body: If Lite keys are valid only for `volcengine-plan`, keep general models separate and add earlier setup/model-selection diagnostics for Lite-key users.

options.title: Support shared keys on both endpoints
options.body: If the same key should work on both endpoints, treat the 401 as a runtime/auth bug and fix the credential/header path with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite routing first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/Coding Plan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses provider auth aliases, bundled plugin ownership, and setup/runtime compatibility surfaces where this history is strongest.
